Question: is the object at the centre of image 1 more consistent with a piece of manufactured hardware (a metal or fabric object with a crisp outline, a shadow of a raised body, unlike its surroundings) or with a natural feature (a rock, a crater rim, a slope, a ripple crest, a frost or dust pattern)?
